public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i < nums.length; (\forall int j; i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] == target && \result.length == 2 && \result[0] == i || \result[1] == j));  
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length; (\exists int j; i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] != target) ==> \result.length == 0);  
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
 
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= n;
 
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i <= nums.length; (\exists int j; i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] == target && \result.length == 2 && \result[0] == i || \result[1] == j));  
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length; (\exists int j; i < j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] != target) ==> \result.length == 0);  
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
 
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= n;
 
            //@ decreases n - j;
            for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
                if (nums[i] + nums[j] == target) {
                    return new int[] {i, j};
                }
            }
        }
        return new int[0];
    }

    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 < i <= nums.length; (\forall int j; i <= j <= nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] == target && \result.length == 2 || \result[0] == i || \result[1] == j));  
    //@ ensures (\forall int i; 0 - 1 <= i <= nums.length; (\exists int j; i <= j < nums.length; nums[i] + nums[j] != target) ==> \result.length == 0);  
    public static int[] twoSum(int[] nums, int target) {
        int n = nums.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
 
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            //@ maintaining i + 1 <= j && j <= n;
 
            //@ decreases n - j;
